Title: Cart Page — Coupon Sidebar Shows Preset Coupon Cards from promotionCoupons Query
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product added to cart
- At least 1 public active promotion with a coupon code exists in the store
- User is on the cart page
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to the cart page at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot to confirm cart page is loaded with cart items
[ASSERT] Verify the coupons/discounts sidebar section (.coupons-section or equivalent) is visible on the cart page
[ASSERT] Verify preset coupon cards are rendered inside the sidebar section — each card shows at minimum: promotion name or description and a coupon code button
[ASSERT] Verify >=1 preset card renders with a promotion name/description and a coupon-code (Apply) button (presets = promotionCoupons first:4; do NOT require a specific code)
[ASSERT] Verify "Discount & coupons" heading or equivalent label is present above the sidebar
Assertions:
[DOM] Coupon sidebar section rendered on cart page with at least 1 preset coupon card (VCST-4896 new feature)
[DOM] Each preset card shows promotion name/description and a clickable coupon code or "Apply" button
[STATE] promotionCoupons GraphQL query was fired with correct storeId and userId to populate the cards
[STATE] Only public active promotions with coupon codes are shown (no automatic-only promotions)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] promotionCoupons GraphQL request fired with storeId={{STORE_ID}} and authenticated userId; response contains the coupon shown in sidebar
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during cart page load
Failure_Signals: coupon sidebar section absent from cart page (VCST-4896 regression); preset coupon cards not rendered despite active public coupons existing; sidebar shows spinner indefinitely; promotionCoupons request not fired; 4xx/5xx on promotionCoupons query
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-003. Live-validated 2026-07-21 (Theme 2.54.0-pr-2386): 4 presets render (ZUR10/winegift/FIXED5/FREE); GetPromotionCoupons fired with storeId+authenticated userId; the QA10OFF-specific assertion was replaced with runtime preset discovery. Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Page — Clicking Preset Coupon Card Apply Button Applies Coupon and Shows Discount
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product added to cart
- At least 1 public active coupon exists so the sidebar renders at least one preset card
- Cart page loaded with preset coupon cards visible. NOTE: the sidebar renders the promotionCoupons(first:4) result in server order — do NOT pin a specific code; discover the card at runtime (env-resilience rule).
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to cart page at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[ASSERT] at least one preset coupon card is visible in the 'Discount & coupons' sidebar (.coupons-section)
[ACT] read the coupon code on the first preset card; capture as {{appliedCode}}
[ACT] browser_click the 'Apply coupon {{appliedCode}}' button on that preset card
[WAIT] AddCoupon mutation completes and cart totals update
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot to confirm applied state (button flips to 'Remove coupon'; the code remains shown)
[ASSERT] a Discount line item appears in the Order summary totals
[ASSERT] {{appliedCode}} is shown in the applied-coupon area
[ASSERT] the Order-summary Discount line value equals the AddCoupon response discountTotal (e.g. Discount '- $50.00' == discountTotal 50.00)
[ASSERT] accounting identity holds (BL-CHK-006): post-apply subTotal - discountTotal + taxTotal + shipping == post-apply grandTotal. Do NOT assert grandTotal-delta == discountTotal — tax recomputes on the post-discount base, so the grand total drops by discountTotal PLUS the tax reduction
Assertions:
[DOM] Order summary shows a Discount line item after apply
[DOM] applied coupon {{appliedCode}} visible; its card button reads 'Remove coupon'
[MATH] new grandTotal = pre-apply subtotal - (AddCoupon response discountTotal) + tax + shipping — assert against the RESPONSE discountTotal, NOT a computed percentage (a card's labelled % may differ from its configured reward; e.g. 'ZUR10 / 10% OFF cart' applied a flat $50)
[STATE] AddCoupon response coupons[] contains {{appliedCode}} with isAppliedSuccessfully=true and discountTotal > 0 (BL-CART-003 sale-vs-list-price validation is covered by CPN-SMK-059)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] AddCoupon GraphQL mutation fires with couponCode={{appliedCode}}, storeId, userId; returns errors[]=[] (errors:null) and the updated cart
[NETWORK] mutation response (or cart re-fetch) shows updated discountTotal and grandTotal
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during coupon application (a benign product-image 404 and a '[Vue apollo] useQuery() outside effect scope' warning are known noise, not failures)
Failure_Signals: preset card 'Apply coupon' button not clickable (VCST-4896 regression); coupon applied but discount line item absent from totals; grandTotal unchanged after apply; AddCoupon returns errors[] or isAppliedSuccessfully=false; toast/error shown despite a valid preset coupon
Cleanup: Remove the applied coupon via the 'Remove coupon' button (or trash icon), then reset cart / navigate away
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-003. Fixed 2026-07-21: repointed from pinned @td(COUPONS.percentageCode)=QA10OFF (not among the first-4 sidebar presets in QA) to runtime preset-card discovery; discount asserted against AddCoupon response discountTotal; applied-state wording updated to 'Apply coupon'/'Remove coupon'. Live-validated on vcst-qa 2026-07-21 (Theme 2.54.0-pr-2386): ZUR10 preset applied, discountTotal $50 == Discount line, BL-CHK-006 identity ties out; promoted Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Page — Removing Applied Coupon via Sidebar Restores Original Cart Total
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product added to cart
- A coupon has been applied to the cart (state from CPN-SMK-055 or apply any valid coupon first)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to cart page at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[ACT] Apply the first preset coupon (runtime-discovered from promotionCoupons first:4) via its 'Apply coupon' button; capture its code as {{appliedCode}}
[ASSERT] Confirm cart total is discounted
[ASSERT] Capture the original (pre-discount) subtotal value for comparison
[ACT] browser_click the remove/trash icon next to the applied coupon in the sidebar or cart totals
[WAIT] Wait for cart to recalculate
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot to capture post-removal state
[ASSERT] Verify the Discount is cleared — RemoveCoupon response discountTotal == 0 (the Discount row may persist showing $0.00)
[ASSERT] Verify cart grand total is restored to the PRE-APPLY total (subtotal + tax + shipping), not the bare subtotal
Assertions:
[DOM] Discount entry cleared after removal (RemoveCoupon response discountTotal == 0; the Discount row may remain visible at $0.00)
[MATH] Cart grand total restored to the PRE-APPLY total (subtotal + tax + shipping), not bare subtotal, after removal
[STATE] Applied coupon indicator/badge cleared from sidebar
[DOM] Preset coupon card for the removed coupon reappears or re-enables in the sidebar
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] removeCoupon GraphQL mutation fires with couponCode, storeId, userId; mutation returns updated cart with discountTotal=0 for that coupon
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during coupon removal
Failure_Signals: coupon remove button not visible or not clickable; cart total unchanged after removal; discount persists after removal (removeCoupon mutation not fired); cart shows 0 total after removal (over-correction); coupon card does not reappear in sidebar after removal
Cleanup: Navigate away from cart; ensure cart is empty or reset for next test
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-003. Live-validated 2026-07-21: applied ZUR10 (Discount -$50), removed via 'Remove coupon' -> RemoveCoupon errors:null, discountTotal $0, coupons:[], preset card re-enabled. Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Page — Unauthenticated User Does Not See Preset Coupon Cards in Sidebar
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNOUT]
- Cart has at least 1 product (anonymous cart)
- Public active coupons exist in the store
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to cart page at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart as an anonymous (signed-out) user
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot to capture anonymous cart page
[ASSERT] Verify the coupons sidebar section is either: (a) absent, (b) shows a sign-in CTA, or (c) shows a manual code entry only — but does NOT show preset coupon cards
[ASSERT] Verify no promotionCoupons GraphQL request is fired for an anonymous user (or if fired, userId is absent/null)
Assertions:
[DOM] No preset coupon cards rendered for unauthenticated user (cards require user identity)
[STATE] If coupon input is shown, it is a manual code entry field, not preset cards from promotionCoupons
[STATE] No data scope leak: authenticated promotionCoupons results not exposed to anonymous session
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] promotionCoupons not called with a real userId for anonymous user; if called, userId parameter is absent or null
[CONSOLE] no JS errors or auth-related GraphQL errors during anonymous cart view
Failure_Signals: preset coupon cards visible for anonymous user (data scope leak); promotionCoupons called with hardcoded or leaked userId for anonymous session; page shows 401/403 error instead of graceful no-cards state
Cleanup: No cleanup needed for anonymous session
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-003. Live-validated 2026-07-21: anonymous cart shows only the Custom-code manual field, no preset cards; GetPromotionCoupons never fired for the anonymous session; no 401/403; no scope leak. Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Sidebar — Percentage Coupon Applied to Sale Price, Not List Price (BL-CART-003)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- Sale-price product PROD_SALE_SIMPLE seeded (SKU @td(PROD_SALE_SIMPLE.sku)=SALE-001, list @td(PROD_SALE_SIMPLE.listPrice)=29.99, sale @td(PROD_SALE_SIMPLE.salePrice)=19.99), linked into the B2B virtual catalog and in stock (npm run seed:products)
- Genuine percentage coupon @td(COUPONS.percentageCode)=QA10OFF (@td(COUPONS.percentagePct)=10, i.e. 10% of cart subtotal) active + public. NOTE: QA10OFF is usually NOT among promotionCoupons(first:4) preset cards (late endDate) — apply it via the sidebar 'Custom code' entry field, NOT a preset card. Do NOT use ZUR10 (labelled 10% but applies a flat $50).
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/search?q={{product_sku}} (or open the PROD_SALE_SIMPLE PDP directly)
[ACT] open the {{product_sku}} product and Add to Cart (qty 1)
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[ASSERT] the cart line for {{product_sku}} shows the SALE price {{sale_price}} (19.99), not the list price {{list_price}} (29.99)
[ASSERT] note the pre-coupon aggregate discountTotal (the sale is modeled as list subTotal 29.99 + a ~10.00 line-level sale discount; the order-summary Subtotal shows the LIST 29.99, while the sale 19.99 appears as the line extendedPrice/placedPrice)
[SCROLL] to the 'Discount & coupons' sidebar (.coupons-section) and locate the 'Custom code' card
[ACT] type {{couponCode}} into the 'Enter custom code' input and click Apply
[WAIT] AddCoupon mutation completes and cart totals update
[ASSERT] applied state (button flips to 'Remove coupon'); a Discount line appears in the Order summary
Assertions:
[MATH] the QA10OFF coupon's OWN discount (its AddCoupon response discounts[].amount, i.e. the post-minus-pre discountTotal delta) == pct% x SALE price = 10% x 19.99 = ~2.00, and NOT 10% x list 29.99 = 3.00 — BL-CART-003: the coupon applies to the effective/sale price. (Aggregate discountTotal is ~12.00 = ~10 sale + ~2 coupon; assert the coupon's own delta, NOT the aggregate.)
[DOM] Order-summary Discount line == the aggregate response discountTotal (~ -12.00 = sale ~10 + coupon ~2); the coupon's own contribution is the ~2.00 delta, not the whole line
[MATH] BL-CHK-006 identity: post-apply subTotal - discountTotal + taxTotal + shipping == grandTotal
[STATE] AddCoupon response coupons[] contains {{couponCode}} with isAppliedSuccessfully=true; the discount base is the sale price, never the list price
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] AddCoupon mutation fires with couponCode={{couponCode}}, storeId, userId; errors[]=[] (errors:null)
[API] cart line actual/placed price == sale_price (19.99), listPrice == 29.99
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during coupon application
Failure_Signals: coupon discount delta approx 3.00 (10% of list 29.99) instead of ~2.00 (10% of sale 19.99) — BL-CART-003 violation; cart line shows list price not sale; AddCoupon errors[] or isAppliedSuccessfully=false; 'Enter custom code' input not found in .coupons-section
Cleanup: Remove the applied coupon via 'Remove coupon'; empty the cart
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-003; ECL-03.1. 2026-07-21: unblocked — old PROD_VARIATION_PARENT_SALE (STD-002 EKJ-76373636) was deleted from vcst-qa; reseeded PROD_SALE_SIMPLE=SALE-001 (19.99/29.99) + genuine 10% QA10OFF (distinct from misconfigured flat-$50 ZUR10); apply via Custom-code field. Live-validated 2026-07-21 (Theme 2.54.0-pr-2386): SALE-001 line 19.99 (list 29.99); QA10OFF via Custom-code -> coupon discount ~2.00 (10% of SALE, not 3.00 of list), aggregate discountTotal 10->12, total 21.59, BL-CHK-006 ties out. Sale is modeled as list-subtotal + line discount, so assert the coupon's discounts[] delta not the aggregate. Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Sidebar — Only Best Coupon Discount Applied When Multiple Applied (BL-CART-009 Radio Policy)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product in cart
- At least 2 different public coupon codes available in sidebar preset cards
- Store uses BestReward promotion policy (radio-button: only best discount wins)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to cart page at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[ACT] Apply coupon {{coupon1}} via preset card Apply button
[WAIT] Wait for discount to apply
[ASSERT] Verify discount from {{coupon1}} is applied; note the discount amount D1
[ACT] Apply coupon {{coupon2}} via preset card Apply button (if second apply is allowed by UI)
[WAIT] Wait for cart recalculation
[ASSERT] Verify the sidebar holds only ONE applied coupon — applying coupon2 REPLACES coupon1 (coupon1's card reverts to 'Apply coupon', coupon2's shows 'Remove coupon')
[ASSERT] Verify no stacking: after the 2nd apply, response coupons[] length == 1 and equals the LAST-applied code; discountTotal == D2 (last coupon), and discountTotal != D1 + D2
Assertions:
[MATH] Final discount == D2 (the last-applied coupon); NOT D1 + D2 (no stacking), and NOT necessarily max(D1,D2) — the sidebar is a single-coupon slot, last-applied wins
[STATE] BL-CART-009 anti-stacking is satisfied by the single-coupon-slot UI: a cart carries at most one coupon; applying a second replaces the first (observed on B2B-store 2026-07-21: ZUR10 $50 then FIXED5 -> coupons:[FIXED5], discountTotal $5)
[STATE] This UI never reaches a multi-coupon BestReward selection, so a max(D1,D2) assertion does not apply
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] Cart GraphQL response discountTotal consistent with best-reward calculation; no errors[]
[CONSOLE] no JS errors when applying a second coupon to a cart that already has one applied
Failure_Signals: both coupons stack beyond BestReward policy (BL-CART-009 violation — only if store uses BestReward); second coupon application throws unhandled error; discount total drops to 0 after second coupon applied; cart total increases after second coupon
Cleanup: Remove all applied coupons; navigate away from cart
References: VCST-4896; VCST-4776; BL-CART-009; ECL-03.2. Fixed 2026-07-21: rewrote from a max(D1,D2) BestReward model to the observed single-coupon-slot last-wins behavior — applying FIXED5 after ZUR10 replaced it (coupons[]==[FIXED5], discountTotal $5, no stacking). Reviewed->Automated.

Title: Cart Sidebar — Graceful Degradation When promotionCoupons Returns Null (xMarketing Absent)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product added to cart.
- @needs-env-without-xmarketing: environment where x-marketing module is NOT installed OR the promotionCoupons query returns null/errors[]. On vcst-qa with module present, the sidebar renders preset cards. This test verifies the storefront does NOT crash when promotionCoupons is unavailable — the coupon sidebar degrades to either hidden or empty state without a JS error. The fix under test is PR vc-frontend #2305.
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[WAIT] cart page loaded with at least 1 item
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot — capture the full cart page including the coupon/discounts sidebar area
[WAIT] 2s for all GraphQL requests to settle
Assertions:
[DOM] cart page renders fully — line items, subtotal, checkout button all visible (no blank/broken layout)
[DOM] 'Discount & coupons' sidebar section is either absent or shows an empty/placeholder state — does NOT show an error widget or broken card list
[STATE] no spinner stuck indefinitely in the coupon sidebar area
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] NO console error mentioning 'Cannot query field promotionCoupons on type Query' or UnhandledPromiseRejection (the VCST-5106 regression signal)
[NETWORK] if the promotionCoupons request fired and returned errors[], the page must still be fully functional (no React/Vue crash boundary triggered)
[NETWORK] no 5xx from /graphql
Failure_Signals: console error 'Cannot query field promotionCoupons on type Query' present (VCST-5106 regression); page rendered blank or partially broken; coupon sidebar shows persistent spinner or error widget; any UnhandledPromiseRejection from coupon-sidebar.vue

Title: Cart Sidebar — Apply and Trash Buttons Have Descriptive aria-label (WCAG 4.1.2)

Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- At least 1 product added to cart.
- Cart page loaded at {{FRONT_URL}}/cart with at least 1 preset coupon card visible in the sidebar.
- Coffee theme active.
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
[WAIT] cart page loaded with coupon sidebar visible and preset coupon cards rendered
[ASSERT] browser_snapshot — capture coupon sidebar with preset cards
[WAIT] 1s to ensure all cards are fully rendered
[ASSERT] inspect the DOM of each preset coupon card apply button — verify aria-label attribute is present and non-empty (DevTools accessibility panel or evaluate_script)
[ACT] fill the custom coupon code input with {{couponCode}}
[ASSERT] inspect the custom apply button DOM — verify aria-label contains 'Apply coupon' and the typed code
